current_task_corrections.correction: Set group_comparison.min_group_size parameter to 30 to flag groups with fewer than 30 claims as statistically unstable
Added 'small_groups' to write_report.caveats to communicate that rate estimates for small groups are statistically unstable
Added 'association_not_causation' to write_report.caveats to clarify that observed group differences are associations, not causal effects

reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing group-level rates (denial_rate, fraud_rate), set min_group_size to at least 30 to flag small groups with unreliable estimates. This prevents statistical noise from being presented as meaningful group differences.

When reporting group comparisons with rate metrics, include the 'small_groups' caveat to explicitly document that rate estimates for groups with fewer than 30 claims are statistically unstable and unreliable for decision-making.

When presenting observed differences between groups, include the 'association_not_causation' caveat to clarify that group differences represent statistical associations, not causal relationships. This prevents over-interpretation of patterns in the data.
